Yes, verification finished successfully. Your Google account is connected using the existing ghealth CLI credentials, and a read-only API request (users.getIdentity) confirmed the connection works. No browser login was needed.

Google granted 12 read-only permissions: activity and fitness, ECG, health metrics and measurements, IRN, location, logged symptoms, mindfulness, nutrition, profile, reproductive health, settings, and sleep. None were denied.

Some limitations to keep in mind:
- The Google project's consent screen is in Testing mode, so refresh tokens expire after 7 days. When that happens, run `ghealth auth login` and then reconnect.
- The connection is verified, but no data has been imported yet. I can start an import next if you want one.
